notes.title: Children of Silentown is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Heyho everyone!

It has been an exciting development cycle ... but we are delighted to announce that today is the day! Our new point&click adventure Children Of Silentown releases TODAY!

[previewyoutube=892bSi29lo0;full][/previewyoutube]

It is finally time for you to get this traditional point&click adventure with modern features, well balanced puzzles and mini games, and a mystery that needs solving! Enjoy the most beautiful soundtrack while exploring this delightfully drawn, Burtonesque world and take in its both wholesome yet eerie vibes.


Interact with the townspeople (and animals!), play with your friends, collect in-game stickers, achievements, and learn more about what no grown-up dares to talk about: the forest. Don’t forget the most important question, though: Who is really faster, the hedgehog or the frog?


Special thanks to everybody who took the time to test and play the free Children Of Silentown Prologue. We appreciate everybody’s interest and support!

Enjoy!
Elf Games, Luna2 Studio and Daedalic Entertainment


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1108000/Children_of_Silentown/

notes.title: Developer Spotlight
notes.notes:
Heyho everone,

Today, Elf Games and Luna2 are shedding light on how Children of Silentown came to be. 
Insights about the unique design of the game as well many more infos are now available in this developer spotlight:

[previewyoutube=y6aNdGfEhws;full][/previewyoutube]

Originally developed as an animated short, Elf Games and Luna2 collaborated to bring the Children of Silentown into the interactive medium. The Making Of video tells the tale of how this suggestion snowballed into the game we see today as a full-fledged title, made by this small group of people in their off-hours from their full-time jobs in software development and full-time content creation on YouTube. 

As we (Daedalic) can testify from first hand experience - the passion this team is spreading is infectious - and if you already feel the same - it's not that long until [b]Children of Silentown releases on January 11th[/b] 

See you then!

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[b]Heyho everyone,[/b]

We’re super excited to announce the release date for Children of Silentown – a dark adventure set in a mysterious community that’s surrounded by an ominous forest. On January 11th, 2023, you’ll be able to discover the secrets hidden within!

[previewyoutube=Jn1aic0Z2r0;full][LINK][/previewyoutube]

Children of Silentown is a dark point-and-click adventure game that follows Lucy, a girl growing up in a village deep in a forest inhabited by monsters, as she slowly begins unravelling the mysteries surrounding her. The unique hand-drawn and eerie art style combined with atmospheric music builds a hauntingly beautiful world for you to explore, solve puzzles and play minigames in, as you slowly peel away the layers of mystery surrounding Lucy’s nightmares and the forest just outside of town.

You’ll be collecting and combining items to solve puzzles, but you’ll also be learning songs to communicate with others and progress through the game, with these songs, you’ll be able to shape and influence Lucy’s story, which will lead to multiple different endings.

notes.title: Update time!
notes.notes:
🔥 Heya all! 🎃


It’s been a long time since we had something to post - but right now, we have something great to share and we want you to take part in our joy:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453367/6026499a26515cf29be838728f19561a812959a4.png[/img]

1) [b]The PC version of the game went "Gold", a.k.a. it’s complete![/b]
Obviously, there are still few more things that need to be prepared for a bombastic release - so it will not be today or tomorrow… but when the time is right, please look forward to an announcement from our publisher Daedalic! 

2) [b]The Prologue to the game recently has passed the 1000 reviews! [/b]
This is already a great achievement in itself, but especially since there is a whole game to follow up - Many thanks to everyone that played the prologue and left their feedback, it’s lovely to see so many of you enjoying it -  this is not just heartwarming but really helps a lot for the upcoming release of Children of Silentown. ❤️

3)[b] Spooky time is upon us! [/b]
Now, we will not be able to release during October (even if we tried 😭) but please, enjoy the spooky holidays to the fullest - the waiting will pay off eventually - that is for sure!!

That’s all for now, may the spook be with you!
Elfs (& Daedalic Entertainment)

notes.title: This Years Steam Awards
notes.notes:
Heya all,

We can't believe it's almost the end of the year already.
Christmas is fast approaching, which also means it's time for the yearly Steam Awards. Children of Silentown is not eligible for this year yet, but rest assured - we're working hard on making a big impression with the main game during the next awards.

On the other hand, though: [b]our "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1451740/Children_of_Silentown_Prologue/]Children of Silentown: Prologue[/url]" is qualified[/b], and we would be honored if you decide to show us your appreciation and nominate it.[b] You can cast your vote until December 1st.[/b]

Pro Tip: If you haven't already, besides voting, leaving a review for the Prologue is part of obtaining a sweet badge from Steam, as well. We would be grateful for your honest opinions

No matter what - we are thankful for everyone who played the Prologue and the demos during the Steam festivals.

It's been quite something of a year, and we hope you're doing as well as it is possible in these times. 

See you soon,
Daedalic Entertainment & 
Elf Games, Luna2 Studio

notes.title: Merry Christmas from Silentown! 🎄
notes.notes:
Ho Ho Ho

Merry Christmas everyone!! 🎄

Hope you are having a great time with family and friends (while keeping social distance) XD

As some of you already know, we at Elf Games are a small team of indie game devs, where most of us have a full-time job. We create games in our spare time (often our sleep time :P) and we are pursuing the development of Children of Silentown for 2 years now, and this year have been... complicated.

Then, we showed you what we achieved so far with our Prologue and your reception has been overwhelming!
35k of you have tried and reviewed it. It was very unexpected and it made us feel grateful for all your feedback and support you showed.

With renewed energies, we wish you happy holidays!
Enjoy the Winter Sales, and see you next year!

and... Beware of nasty cats!

𝕋𝕙𝕖 𝕗𝕠𝕣𝕖𝕤𝕥 𝕚𝕤 𝕕𝕒𝕣𝕜 𝕒𝕟𝕕 𝕤𝕥𝕚𝕝𝕝, 𝕟𝕠 𝕣𝕠𝕒𝕣𝕤 𝕨𝕚𝕝𝕝 𝕓𝕖 𝕙𝕖𝕒𝕣𝕕 𝕥𝕠𝕟𝕚𝕘𝕙𝕥!”[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35453367/8e703284ebad839fcd4a1a920b1bbb599d6d3e2e.png[/img]

Those of Silentown quiet, whispering beings. They fear the growls of the night, they stay away from the dark.
But there is a special event, a line between two worlds, that mixes the shivers of risk with the party vibes.
Kids roam the street louder than the monsters and no beast would dare to come close, fearing the ol’ Trick or Treat!

Happy Halloween to y’all - remember to wear a mask as all the cool kids do, and don’t accept candies from strangers (if ya do, remember to wash yer hands)
